fusions.name: Loosed Mid-Stride
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Parting Shot
fusions.desc: A heavy arrow that deals 13 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles. It throws the target back 3 tiles and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Breathing Room
fusions.desc: Hops you 3 tiles from where you stood and increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Strung by Stride
fusions.desc: Every stretch of ground you cover, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
